description: This is a source file for the AgentService class, which implements a core service for a reactive agent using tools and chat models. It manages chat interactions, tool execution, and the agent's decision-making process.

classes.name: AgentException
classes.description: Custom exception class used for handling errors within the agent's operation, with different error types and messages.

classes.name: AgentService
classes.description: Core reactive agent service managing conversation flow, tool execution, and agent state.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the agent state including the message history, steps, and running flag.

methods.name: runAgent
methods.description: Executes the agent loop with user input, managing message exchange, tool actions, and step logging.

methods.name: _addStep
methods.description: Internal method to add a new step to the agent's step list with a timestamp.

methods.name: _setupTools
methods.description: Initializes available tools for the agent, including file reading/writing, time retrieval, and calculations.

methods.name: _executeAction
methods.description: Executes a tool action based on parsed action string.

methods.name: _parseAction
methods.description: Parses an action string into tool name and arguments.

methods.name: _parseArguments
methods.description: Parses string arguments within an action call.

methods.name: _extractContent
methods.description: Extracts content between specified XML tags from the agent's generated text.

methods.name: _generateSystemPrompt
methods.description: Generates the initial system prompt instructing the agent on step-by-step reasoning and format.
